proposals: FBIL should publish a free, downloadable daily history of its reference rates, including JPY/INR, linked to the RBI reference-rate archive that ends in July 2018, so that ten-year rupee comparisons like this one can rest on the official series rather than a commercial data feed.

The RBI should publish, in its quarterly external-debt release, the share of yen and other foreign-currency corporate borrowing that is hedged, so that exposure behind a figure like the roughly 5.8% yen share of external debt can be read from official data rather than secondary market research.

The RBI should include a funding-currency shock in its Financial Stability Report stress tests, sized on the yen’s 7.7% rise against the rupee in nine trading days in 2024, and publish the result for unhedged corporate borrowers, so that a repeat unwind is assessed in advance.
